data.name: PermissionDenied
data.value: You do not have permission to perform this action.

data.name: NotAuthenticated
data.value: You must be signed in to a tenant to perform this action.

data.name: WorkflowNotFound
data.value: The Case Workflow was not found or you do not have access to it.

data.name: KeyRequired
data.value: The journal needs a payload field name to match.

data.name: ValueRequired
data.value: The journal needs a value to match.

data.name: KeyInvalid
data.value: The payload field name must be at most 256 characters with no control characters.

data.name: LensInvalid
data.value: The lens must be payload, rules, features, models or sanctions.

data.name: LimitInvalid
data.value: The limit must be between 1 and 5000.

data.name: PeriodInvalid
data.value: 'From' must be before 'To', and the window at most 3660 days.

data.name: SectionInvalid
data.value: A section must be one of summary, notable, progression, distributions, velocity, gaps, novelty, counterparties, correlation, drift or peers.

data.name: TransactionNotFound
data.value: The transaction was not found for this Case Workflow.

data.name: TransactionIdInvalid
data.value: The transaction id must be above zero.

data.name: TagTransactionsInvalid
data.value: Between one and 500 transactions are needed, and no transaction may repeat.

data.name: TagChangeRequired
data.value: At least one Tag to add or remove is needed.

data.name: TagNameInvalid
data.value: A Tag name must have text and be at most 256 characters.

data.name: TagUnknown
data.value: Every Tag to add must be an active Tag of the workflow's model.

data.name: TagLimitInvalid
data.value: No more than 20 Tags may be added, removed or held at once.

data.name: PinTransactionsInvalid
data.value: Between one and 50 transactions are needed, and no transaction may repeat.

data.name: TravelLimitInvalid
data.value: The speed limit must be between 1 and 10,000 kilometres an hour and the shortest leg between 0 and 20,000 kilometres.

data.name: ReplayNotFound
data.value: The saved replay was not found on this case.

data.name: ReplayNameInvalid
data.value: A replay needs a name of between 1 and 100 characters.

data.name: ReplayWindowInvalid
data.value: A replay looks back 7, 30, 90 or 365 days.

data.name: ReplayLimitInvalid
data.value: A case can have no more than 10 saved replays.

data.name: PinLimitInvalid
data.value: A case can have no more than 50 pinned transactions.

data.name: CaseNotFound
data.value: The case was not found.

data.name: CaseLocked
data.value: The case is locked to another user.

data.name: FilterInvalid
data.value: The filter is not valid. It needs a group of rules, each with a field of the model, an operator that suits the field and a value of the field's type.

data.name: FilterUnreadable
data.value: The filter could not be applied because a stored value could not be read as the type of the field it was compared with.

data.name: MergeInvalid
data.value: Merge needs a JSON array of at most three objects, each with a key and a value, beyond the case key.

data.name: TagJobTooManyMatches
data.value: Too many transactions match to tag them in one job. Narrow the view and try again.

data.name: TagJobNoMatches
data.value: No transaction matches the view.

data.name: TagJobNotFound
data.value: The tagging job was not found.

data.name: TagJobNotUndoable
data.value: Only a finished tagging that changed something and has not already been undone can be undone.
